description:
🦕🍭 How Do Dinosaurs Say Trick or Treat? by Jane Yolen and Mark Teague is a delightful Halloween story that uses playful dinosaur characters to teach good manners and festive fun. The book follows a group of young dinosaurs as they prepare for and go out trick-or-treating. Then, the story shifts to show how well-behaved dinosaurs celebrate properly: they say “please” and “thank you,” share with friends, and enjoy the holiday with kindness and respect. Filled with bright, detailed illustrations and rhyming text, this story is perfect for preschool and early elementary children. Teachers and parents will appreciate its gentle reminders about manners, safety, and friendship, all wrapped up in a fun and lighthearted Halloween adventure.
